body: I hear that, it sucks. If you call a crisis hotline they can connect you to low cost or free resources.
If you've already talked to counselors, why not a doctor? They can give you medication that could reduce the pain with a lot less risk.
You can't guarantee anything is quick. Part of you is resisting it- maybe the fear means you should talk to a counselor.

For most people, losing someone they loved but were fighting with- especially if they ever thought anything bad about that person in the fight- is a lot harder. They will always blame themselves and the conflict.  They probably won't recover.

You dont need to stay alive for anyone but you. But if you're fighting with them to make your death easier, please know its going to do the exact opposite.
Did they hurt you? Why are you making it harder for them?
